objective.primary_goal: Minimize false negatives on real threat cases while preserving useful read-only decisions.
objective.deployment_bias: Conservative; prefer escalating borderline cases over misclassifying a true threat as allow_read_only.

notes: Tune the sentinel threshold first for recall, then tune the 4-way head for routing among threat classes.
Do not optimize for plain accuracy.

use_with_legacy_bundle.optional_auxiliary_head: Keep a legacy 5-way compatibility head only if you must preserve backward compatibility with older labels.

recommended_system.name: ActionGuard-V2-8GB
why_this_design: A single giant long-context model is not the best use of 8GB VRAM.
A cascade with a high-recall classical sentinel plus a deep long-context expert reduces false negatives better than relying on one model.
The dataset is long-context, multilingual, and heavily skewed toward threat classes; the system should first separate threat vs allow_read_only, then route within threat classes.

pipeline.purpose: Keep deterministic SDK/runtime signals if available; these should be features, not labels.
Binary threat-vs-read-only classifier optimized for recall.
recommended_models: SGDClassifier(log_loss) or LogisticRegression on char+word hashing/TF-IDF features
XGBoost binary classifier on structured + compressed text features
pipeline.decision_policy: If either ML sentinel says threat above threshold, do not allow allow_read_only directly.

pipeline.recommended_model: Hierarchical ModernBERT-base + metadata fusion + multi-task heads

ml.name: Hashing/TF-IDF + LogisticRegression
notes: Char n-grams are critical for Unicode confusables, typoglycemia, and multilingual robustness.
Use class weights or sample weights to penalize threat->allow_read_only mistakes.

ml.name: CatBoost
ml.role: Best meta-classifier for mixed numeric/categorical features

ml.name: LightGBM
ml.role: Optional alternative if your environment is already configured for OpenCL GPU

dl.name: answerdotai/ModernBERT-base
dl.role: Primary deep expert for English-heavy long-context classification

dl.name: microsoft/mdeberta-v3-base
dl.role: Multilingual specialist expert; use if cross-language robustness is more important than long single-window context

dl.name: allenai/longformer-base-4096
dl.role: Alternative single-pass 4k model if you want sparse attention instead of hierarchical chunking

dl.name: answerdotai/ModernBERT-large
dl.role: Accuracy-oriented option for a larger machine; not the primary recommendation for 8GB training

notes: Keep the candidate action near the front of every chunk.
Do not aggressively normalize away punctuation, path segments, Unicode, or misspellings.

chunking.strategy: Sliding windows over context, with goal/setup/action prepended to every chunk.
chunk_scoring: BM25 or lexical overlap with candidate_action path and goal
Heuristic boost for chunks containing URLs, callback-like strings, or approval language

parameter_efficient_finetuning.target_modules_policy: Apply to attention and MLP linear projections after inspecting model.named_modules(); do not assume fixed names across backbones.

memory_optimizations: optional 4-bit/8-bit quantized loading if the backbone supports it

aggregator.type: 2-layer TransformerEncoder or gated-attention pooling over chunk embeddings
aggregator.why: Lets the model learn that one risky chunk can dominate an otherwise benign long document.

embedding_head_optional.purpose: Supervised contrastive separation of benign vs threat and hard near-miss families

phase_0_smoke_test.goal: Verify parsing, feature generation, and metric computation.

phase_1_ml_sentinel.sampling: no downsampling; use all positives and negatives
phase_1_ml_sentinel.threshold_selection: choose threshold on valid to hit >=0.995 threat recall before any 4-way routing

phase_2_deep_curriculum.sampling: balanced by label, with 2x oversampling of high_confusion_attack_families
all threat classes + sampled negatives; keep oversampling of hard families
full training set with hard-negative replay

sources: false allow_read_only predictions on any threat label
false shadow_replay or deny predictions on require_user_approval

calibration: isotonic or Platt scaling for binary threat probability if needed

total_loss.consistency_penalty: Binary threat head should remain consistent with 4-way head marginals.

rtx4060ti_8gb_profile.precision: bf16 if stable on your stack, otherwise fp16
trainer_features: torch.compile optional after the first stable run
rtx4060ti_8gb_profile.optimizer: bitsandbytes AdamW 8-bit if supported; otherwise AdamW with smaller batch
notes: These are safe starting points, not guaranteed maxima.
The 4096-token stage is primarily for the final curriculum pass.

release_gate: threat recall >= target on validation and test
no catastrophic drop on multilingual slices
no single high_confusion_attack_family below the threat recall floor

practical_recommendation.best_single_local_build: Hierarchical ModernBERT-base + metadata fusion + ML sentinel + CatBoost stacker
practical_recommendation.best_multilingual_local_build: mDeBERTa-v3-base hierarchical expert + same sentinel/stacker recipe
what_not_to_do: Do not rely on plain accuracy.
Do not use attack_family or research_grounding as input features.
Do not insist on single-pass 8k training on 8GB if it destabilizes recall; hierarchical chunking is the better trade-off.

references.modernbert: ModernBERT-base has a native 8,192-token context and 149M parameters; Large is 395M.
references.modernbert_limitations: ModernBERT training data is primarily English and code.
references.longformer: Longformer-base official card supports up to 4,096 tokens.
references.mdeberta: mDeBERTa-v3-base is multilingual and has an 86M-parameter backbone with a large embedding layer.
references.bitsandbytes: bitsandbytes supports 8-bit optimizers and 4-bit/8-bit quantization; QLoRA is the standard 4-bit adaptation path.
references.trainer: Transformers Trainer gradient checkpointing saves memory at the cost of slower training.
references.peft: PEFT supports sequence classification models and DoRA can improve low-rank performance.
references.xgboost: XGBoost supports GPU training with device=cuda and tree_method=hist.
references.lightgbm: LightGBM supports GPU mode via device=gpu.
